subject: Compact executive passoff: CTO standby & proxy protocol
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@earnings-sys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kumar <priya@findex.co.uk>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — CTO availability for a 20-min compact brief

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the last session — the team at Earnings liked the performance numbers. We have a tight exec window next Wednesday (Dec 16) where our CIO and CTO will be joining for engineering approvals. Can your CTO join for a 20-minute compact brief between 10:00–11:30 PT? If not, would you propose a proxy plan: a 5–10 minute CTO intro + a lead engineer to run the demo?

We're trying to keep the session short because the CIO needs to jump to another meeting. If you can share a short agenda and who would be on the call from your side, that'd help us finalize invites.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Infrastructure Purchasing
Earnings Systems

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@earnings-sys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Priya Kumar <priya@findex.co.uk>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — CTO availability for a 20-min compact brief

Hi Samir — appreciate the heads-up.

We can support a compact 20-minute block on Dec 16 but our CTO has a conflicting all-hands at 10:15 PT. Proposal: 10:00–10:20 PT with a two-part plan:
- 10:00–10:05 PT: CTO quick intro and top-line fit / security assurances (CTO, remote)
- 10:05–10:20 PT: Lead engineer demo + Q&A (Ben will run the demo).

If your CIO needs to drop earlier, we can front-load the CTO remarks and record the demo for on-demand follow-up. Attached a short agenda and the internal demo runbook for our suggested flow.

Please confirm whether 10:00 PT works and whether the CIO needs the CTO to stay beyond 10:05. If the CTO cannot appear live at all, Ben can do a 2-minute recorded CTO intro and then hand to the demo.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: compact-brief-agenda.pdf, demo-runbook.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@earnings-sys.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Priya Kumar <priya@findex.co.uk>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — CTO availability for a 20-min compact brief

On Wed, Dec 9, 2026 at 11:04 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> We can support a compact 20-minute block on Dec 16 but our CTO has a conflicting all-hands at 10:15 PT. Proposal: 10:00–10:20 PT with a two-part plan:

Samir — quick logistics from my side:
- I will be the primary demo driver (10:05–10:20).
- If CTO can do 10:00–10:03 live, perfect. If not, I will play a 90-second recorded intro from CTO then transition.
- I recommend we keep slide count to 4 (problem, runtime, SLA/readouts, next steps) and allocate 6–8 minutes for architecture Q&A.

Operational asks: please add a 5-min buffer in the invite for handshake and recording start. Also confirm whether screen-recording is allowed on your end.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Samir Patel <samir@earnings-sys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kumar <priya@findex.co.uk>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — CTO availability for a 20-min compact brief

Thanks Marissa and Ben — 10:00–10:20 PT on Dec 16 works for our CIO. He asked that the CTO be present at kickoff for at least the first 3 minutes to confirm security posture; otherwise the recorded intro is acceptable.

We will allow recording (internal compliance OK) and will add a 5-minute buffer in the invite. I just sent a calendar hold — please accept and I'll add the Zoom link and dial-in.

Samir

Attachments: calendar-hold.ics

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@earnings-sys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — CTO availability for a 20-min compact brief

Great — confirmed on our end. Final checklist before the brief:
- Marissa: will the CTO confirm live intro or provide a 90s recorded clip?
- Ben: final demo slide deck (4 slides) + 1-liner for each slide by EOD Dec 14.
- Samir: please post the Zoom link and attendee list (CIO + CTO + procurement).

I'll send the finalized calendar invite once the CTO presence is confirmed. Thanks all — we will keep it tightly timed and recorded.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Program Manager, Customer Engagement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
